run_save_sharded_state: run the CLI script to save a vLLM model's sharded state checkpoint to a specified output directory
run_parse_args: run the parse_args function to build an argument parser with model, output, file-pattern, and max-file-size options
run_main: run the main function to load a vLLM model, save its sharded state, and copy metadata files to the output directory
run_engine_save_sharded_state: run save_sharded_state on an LLM engine core to dump worker state dicts as sharded safetensors files
run_load_sharded_state: run LLM with load_format='sharded_state' to load a previously saved sharded checkpoint efficiently
